item.title: Triple‐Coupling Regulation Enables Dendrite‐Free Subzero Aqueous Zn‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work introduces a triple-coupling strategy—solvation, interfacial chemistry, and crystallographic orientation—via a formamide-ethanol deep eutectic electrolyte. It enables dendrite-free Zn deposition along the (101) facet, achieving 1400 h cycling at −20°C and 99.78% Coulombic efficiency. This molecular-to-interfacial design offers a promising route for temperature-resilient aqueous Zn-ion batteries.
